originality.rationale: The exact finite-variable invariant for all widths and the exceptional 26-class width-two spectrum were not established in the inspected primary papers. The nearest same-signature primary source, Albert–Bouvel–Féray, proves full FO cycle-type/isomorphism and investigates joint TOTO/TOOB expressibility; this does not imply exact FO^2 or FO^k equivalence. Grohe–Otto supplies pebble characterizations, not component-specific classifications. A prior exact quantifier-rank-three enumeration and work on permutation *functions* have different resource bounds or syntax; the restricted-partition Euler identity itself is classical and is not claimed as independently new. Broader undiscovered composition results remain a priority risk.
residual_risks: An unlocated general composition or preservation theorem for structures consisting of finite cycles might imply the entire classification without matching the searched titles.
Some older or specialized exact permutation-logic classifications may be absent from inspected indices.
The 2015 counting/equivalence article was inspected through accessible abstract/introduction only; despite differing signature, complete text was not checked for every incidental application.
The classic restricted-partition Euler product is not by itself original; novelty is asserted for the full logical characterization and two-variable exception.

value.rationale: A complete sharp classification for the elementary one-bijection relational structures yields a striking low-width exception (exactly 26 FO² types), a jump to infinitely many FO³ theories, an exact k-variable threshold for every cycle multiplicity, and unique smallest models. This clarifies the expressive border between local adjacency patterns and global cycle structure. The 10-vertex maximum width-two minimum model and its polynomial census provide concrete natural invariants; the classical partition identity is only a consequence, not the sole source of value.
